description: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) - A standardized document required by the Affordable Care Act that health insurance plans must provide to enrollees, summarizing key plan features in a uniform format. It typically includes the plan name, coverage period, deductible amounts (in-network and out-of-network), out-of-pocket maximums, copayments and coinsurance for common services, and a list of excluded or limited services. The first page usually displays the plan name, insurer logo, coverage dates, and a summary table of deductibles and out-of-pocket limits. The last page typically contains coverage examples (e.g., having a baby, managing a chronic condition) illustrating estimated patient costs, along with a reference to the uniform glossary of health coverage terms
